text: The author employs an alternating first-person point of view, allowing the narrative to shift between different members of a space expedition team. This structural choice facilitates a multi-faceted exploration of the story’s events. The tone is dynamic, contrasting the optimistic and curious perspective of the scientist with the pragmatic and cautious outlook of the engineer. Additionally, the language varies in register: it remains technical when describing machinery and phenomena, but transitions to a more reflective and philosophical mode when the characters contemplate their existence and place in the universe.
